key_lessons: Verify factual claims in dispatch prompts. T16 round-1 told the worker dev/research/f3_bipedal::Bipedal3 didn't exist — wrong, cost a rework cycle.
[hard] criterion amendments must be visible in JIT issue description, NOT just source-code comments. Reviewer LLM reads the description's literal text.
Pre-amend incoherent criteria (e.g. 'N elements' where N > LANES_const) BEFORE dispatch. Don't punt to worker interpretation.

When making AVX2 entry points generic over per-prime config, lane shape (Mag/Sgn) belongs as associated types on the config trait, not as separate generics on the generic struct. Reviewer's reading of 'plug-in points' included lane selection.

Lead-direct mechanical fixes (doc bound corrections, narrative refreshes, criterion amendment recording) are appropriate for narrowly scoped Tier 2.5/2.75 fixes where dispatching a worker would burn 10+ min for a 30-second edit. NOT appropriate for code changes that should iterate.
Worktree+excluded-hip cargo metadata error is environmental: `cargo fmt --all` from a worktree fails. Use `cargo fmt -p <crate> -- --check` from worktree, or run `cargo fmt --all` from main.
